questions.passage: Our five senses – sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch – are very important. They help us learn and stay safe. Our eyes help us see colorful things around us. Our ears help us hear different sounds, like music and birds. Our nose helps us smell beautiful flowers. Our tongue helps us taste delicious food. Our hands help us touch soft and hard things. Our senses work together every day.

questions.text: It's very important to stay healthy.
questions.passage: To stay healthy, it's very important to do three things! First, eat fresh and colorful foods like fruits and vegetables, and make sure to drink lots of water every day. Second, be active and play outside! Running, jumping, and riding your bike are great ways to make your body strong. Third, sleep for eight hours so your body can rest and grow. And don't forget to wash your hands and brush your teeth.
